final_candidates.what_is_new_vs_baseline: Spatial hit regions are absent from the supplied selectable=false plus dragHandle baseline.
final_candidates.changed_choice: Keep selection enabled; make the outer node wrapper pointer-transparent and restore targeting on its handle.

final_candidates.expected_output: Body targets B; handle targets A's descendant and bubbles. React Flow selection remains a proposed integration expectation.
final_candidates.conditions_supported: Descendant overrides inheritance; ancestor handlers remain active.
final_candidates.limitations: DOM rule; React Flow integration and dragging untested.
final_candidates.counter_evidence: Focus navigation survives; text selection and hit-test corner cases remain qualified.
